[ea]No, you can’t sell me to science!

[ea]They throwed me outsss the house, and I floated

[ea][a8]gurgle[a9] It’s terrible.

dialogues.text:
[ea]Maybe I don’t looksss it, but I’m very fastidious

dialogues.speaker: Igor Folds
dialogues.text:
[df]I sink to myself, now who could zat be?
But it’s just you. Vat do you vant?

dialogues.speaker: Igor Folds
dialogues.text:
[df][a8]shrug[a9] Ze laboratory zat I used in ze old days is
over zere.

dialogues.speaker: Igor Folds
dialogues.text:
[df]But now ze door is locked wiz a key, and I can’t
get in.

dialogues.speaker: Igor Folds
dialogues.text: [df]My old research partner used to have ze key...

dialogues.speaker: Igor Folds
dialogues.text:
[df]But he is gone now, and not even I, ze great Igor
Folds, can open ze door.

dialogues.speaker: Igor Folds
dialogues.text:
[df]So you vould like to know who my ‘research
partner’ vas...?

dialogues.speaker: Igor Folds
dialogues.text:
[df][a8]shrug[a9] No, I vill not speak of zat man.
He is gone. Let it be over now.

dialogues.speaker: Black Jacques
dialogues.text:
[ea]Ah, it is my leetle chum, [f5].
But maybe, you not so leetle any more, eh?

dialogues.speaker: Black Jacques
dialogues.text:
[ea]Everyone at CELL, zey know who is ze man that
stopped ze catastrophe.

dialogues.speaker: Black Jacques
dialogues.text:
[ea]You are a ’ero, young [f5].
You saved ze Green Bays.

dialogues.speaker: Black Jacques
dialogues.text:
[ea]Never did I sink zat a young boy and ’is leetle
monsters...

dialogues.speaker: Black Jacques
dialogues.text: [ea]...could grow strong enough to save ze world!

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]It’s a simple little test [96] you just have to bring me
some monsters.

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]Of course, they have to be the right KIND of
monsters...

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]...and sometimes, finding them isn’t so easy.
It takes brains as well as brawn.

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]But the good news is, you can keep all the
monsters that you show me.

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]And IF you bring the right ones, I’ll even reward
you with a little prize.

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]It’ll cost you five gold coins to play.
What do you say?

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]Now, problem number three... Oh, hang on.
It’s too soon for that.

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]We can’t continue until after the opening ceremony
of the challenge has taken place on Domus Isle.

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]Next prob[96] er, wait... There aren’t any.
You’ve completed all ten!
dialogues.comment: ファイナルが発生しない状態

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]I’ll need time to prepare a new test.
Come back later, young man.

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]This is the home of Infant Isle’s famous Monster
Scout Proficiency Test.

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]Well, young scout. You’ve completed the Monster
Scout Proficiency Test...
[f1][fb][fd]
Which means you’re ready for something a little
more challenging!

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]TA-DA! It’s time for the Advanced Monster Scout
Proficiency Test!

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]The rules are the same [96] you bring me the monsters
I tell you to.

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]But now the problems are VERY tricky. You’ll need
to put your thinking cap on, lad [96] and keep it on!

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]Now then, it’ll cost you the princely sum of
1000 gold coins. Still want to take the test?

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]Next prob[96] er, wait... There aren’t any.
You’ve completed all ten!

dialogues.text:
[df]Aye, you’re a fine scout indeed, to pass such a
difficult test.

dialogues.text:
[df]This is the Advanced Monster Scout Proficiency
Test. Your task is not so simple...

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]The ghoulish ghost that I seek may have a grin on
its bony face, but it really is a very unhappy soul.

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]Well, you would be unhappy too if you had been
through what this poor soul has endured.

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]Well, young scout?
Do you have the monster that I asked for?

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:

Test. Your task is not so simple...

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]The many-armed demon I seek wears a skull
around its neck.

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]Be careful [96] it’s a MAL-evolent, WRATH-ful old
devil!

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]Well, young scout?
Do you have the monster that I asked for?

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]This is the Advanced Monster Scout Proficiency
Test. Your task is not so simple...

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]I’m sure you still have fond memories of your first
monster, so bring me one of that type!

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]Well, young scout?
Do you have the monster that I asked for?

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]Tsk. It doesn’t look like you’ve found the monster
I’m seeking.

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]Take your time, sonny.
Think about it again, and try a different monster.

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]Bravo, young man!
You’ve solved problem number [d0] !

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]Remember [96] scouting monsters is the most basic
skill you must master.

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df][d0]1[d0]W can certainly use cypress
staves.

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text: [df]Ghosts do indeed appear on this island at night.

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]Stump chumps do indeed appear on this island at
night.

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text: [df]Winkies do indeed appear on this island at night.

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df][d0]1[d0]W do belong to the 
dragon family.

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df][d0]1[d0]W are Rank E monsters,
without a doubt.
dialogues.comment: モンスター名をセット

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]A scout isn’t really a scout until he’s learnt how
to synthesise.

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]Keep practising those skills and your team will be
unbeatable.

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]The mud mannequin is indeed a Rank C monster of
the material family.

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]The dingaling is indeed a Rank C monster of the
material family.

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]The hunter mech is indeed a Rank C monster of the
material family.

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]The puppeteer is indeed a Rank C monster of the
material family.

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text: [df]Here is your prize [96] a darkonium crystal!

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]Some monsters exist only through the power of
synthesis.

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]Never hesitate to experiment.
Who knows what you might create?

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text: [df]Ooh, goody, you’ve brought me a king slime!

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text: [df]I do love how they wobble so!

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]A Rank A [d0]V?
You’ve done well, young scout.
dialogues.comment: モンスター名をセット

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]Here is your reward [96] a rather dangerous-looking
pair of metal talons.
dialogues.comment: モンスター名をセット

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text: [d0]1[f5] receives a pair of metal talons!
dialogues.comment: モンスター名をセット

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]Well then, young [f5].
You’ve solved all ten problems.
dialogues.comment: モンスター名をセット

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]Which means [96] if I’m not very much mistaken [96] that
you’ve passed the Monster Scout Proficiency Test!
dialogues.comment: モンスター名をセット

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]I’ll need time to prepare a new test.
Come back later, young man.
dialogues.comment: ノーマルは終了：Fはまだ

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]Hmmm... How about...? Ah yes! ...Actually, no.
Too easy. Hmmm... What else is there?
[f1][fb][fd]
Perhaps...hmmm... Aha! That might be good!
...But no one would ever find one... Hmmm...
[f1][fb][fd]
...FINISHED!
Ahem, the new test is ready!

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text: [df]Just talk to me when you feel like taking it!

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text: [df]I’m afraid that’s not right.

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]You have to really, REALLY think about it.
Now go and bring me another monster.

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]Bravo, young man!
You’ve solved problem number [d0] !

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]What green-coloured slime likes to think it’s a
courageous steed, night OR day?

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text: [df]Why, a slime knight, of course!

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]The answer is a spitnik!
It likes to spit, you see.

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text: [df]Hmph. What are you looking at me like that for?

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]You’ve never heard of a spittoon?
Well, I didn’t say it would be easy!

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]This one was a bit on the easy side, I thought.
It was a green dragon, of course.

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text: [df]I mean, there’s no such thing as Bubble Slime Quest!

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]You’ve brought a great argon lizard.
It’s a ‘G-rate’ monster indeed!
dialogues.comment: 正解：アルゴングレート

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]You’ve brought a great dracky.
It’s a ‘G-rate’ monster indeed!

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]You’ve brought a great sabrecat.
It’s a ‘G-rate’ monster indeed!

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]You’ve brought a great dragon.
It’s a ‘G-rate’ monster indeed!
dialogues.comment: 正解：グレイトドラゴン

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]You’ve brought a great sabrecub.
It’s a ‘G-rate’ monster indeed!

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]Now that problem was better than good, wasn’t it!?
Heh heh heh!

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text: [df]I asked for a ‘manly’ monster...

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]In short, I was looking for a monster with ‘man’ in
its name!

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text: [df]So your anchorMAN is perfect!

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text: [df]So your phantom swordsMAN is perfect!
dialogues.comment: 正解：ソードファントム

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text: [df]So your mud MANnequin is perfect!

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text: [df]So your merMAN is perfect!

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text: [df]That’s right [96] I was seeking a living statue!

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]What other stony-faced monster was meant to
stand on a pedestal...

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text: [df]...but now stomps around wherever it pleases?

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]What canny, man-eating monster thinks outside the
box?

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]Why, a cannibox, of course!
You’re sharper than you look, young man.

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]What ghostly ghoul can’t stop grinning,
even though it’s deeply unhappy?

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]Yes, yes. It could be none other than a skull-faced
tortured soul.

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]...Although, names are deceiving.
Some of them can be quite good company...

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]Yes, yes, well done. The malroth is a MAL-evolent
and WRATH-ful old devil.

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]You are a mighty scout indeed, to bring me a
Rank S monster!

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]The truth is, I have no idea what your first ever
monster was.

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]But surely you must know.
So I suppose you’re correct!

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]Here’s your prize [96] a pair of amazingly durable
orichalcum claws. Couldn’t blunt ’em if you tried!

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text: [d0]1[f5] receives a pair of orichalcum claws!

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]Well, well, [f5].
You’ve solved all ten problems...

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]...and, sadly, my Advanced Monster Scout
Proficiency Test is over.

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]On a more positive note, you’ve fulfilled one of the
two conditions for entry into Solitaire’s Challenge.

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]Aye, you did very well indeed.
Those problems were not at all easy!

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text: [df]It’s been an honour to meet a scout of your calibre!

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text: [df]This is your prize [96] [d0]H.
dialogues.comment: 共通アイテム取得処理

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[d0]1[f5] receives
[d0]H.
dialogues.comment: 共通アイテム取得処理

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]Now, problem number three...
Oh, hang on. It’s too soon for that.

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]We can’t continue until after the opening ceremony
of the challenge has taken place on Domus Isle.

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]Now, the Monster Scout Proficiency Test consists of
ten problems.

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]The next problem will cost [d0]8 gold coins.
Do you want to hear it?

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]Now, the Advanced Monster Scout Proficiency Test
consists of ten problems.
dialogues.comment: 次のファイナル出題へ

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]The next problem will cost [d0]8 gold coins.
Do you want to hear it?
dialogues.comment: 次のファイナル出題へ

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text: [df]Now go and find me the monster I seek!
dialogues.comment: モンスターを見せない

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]Now, problem number three...
Oh, hang on. It’s too soon for that.

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]We can’t continue until after the opening ceremony
of the challenge has taken place on Domus Isle.

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]Aye, welcome. Scoutmaster Shuffles, at your
service. Perhaps you’ve heard of me?
[f1][fb][fd]
I’m the man who runs this island’s famous Monster
Scout Proficiency Test.

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]It will cost you [d0]8 gold coins.
Are you willing to try?

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]Aye, I’m Scoutmaster Shuffles, as I think you
already know.
[f1][fb][fd]
I’m the man who runs the Advanced Monster Scout
Proficiency Test.

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]Do you wish to take the test?
It will cost you [d0]8 gold coins.

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]Good, let’s begin! Listen carefully to problem
number [d0]  of the Monster Scout Proficiency Test!

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text: [df]Bring me a monster that you’ve scouted!

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text: [df]Now, go!

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text: [df]Bring me a monster that can equip a cypress staff!

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]Perhaps you know that you can equip your monsters
with weapons?

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text: [df]Now, go and find that monster!

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]Bring me a monster that only appears on this island
at night!

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]Different monsters appear when day turns to night.
Bring me one of them.

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text: [df]Now, go!

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text: [df]Bring me a monster of the dragon family!

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]There are many different monster families.
Dragons form one such group.

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]An icon next to the monster’s name shows the
family it belongs to.

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text: [df]Now, go!

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text: [df]Bring me a Rank E monster!

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text: [df]The monster’s rank shows how powerful it is.

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]It might seem hard to believe, but there are
monsters out there ranked even higher than A!

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text: [df]Now, go!

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text: [df]Bring me a monster that you’ve synthesised!

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]Any kind of synthesised monster at all.
I don’t care what kind.

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text: [df]Now, go out there and synthesise!

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]You have to bring me a Rank C monster that is
ALSO of the material family.

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text: [df]Can you find a monster that meets both conditions?

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text: [df]Now, go!

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text: [df]I’ll make it simple [96] just bring me a jumping jackal!

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]But I should tell you [96] you won’t find this monster
anywhere in Green Bays.

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]So how are you going to get one?
Think very, very carefully now...

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text: [df]Now, go!

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]Bring me a king slime [96] from this island or
anywhere else!

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]Where can you find one?
That’s a problem for YOU to solve!

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]If scouting one is too difficult, synthesising is
always an option...

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text: [df]Now, go!

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text: [df]Bring me a Rank A monster!

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]By the way, I don’t care if you scouted it or
synthesised it yourself.

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]This is the very last problem in the Monster Scout
Proficiency Test. You can solve it if you try!

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]Now, are you ready? Problem [d0]  of the Advanced
Monster Scout Proficiency Test!

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]Bring me a green slime that thinks it’s a courageous
steed!

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]...Oh, and despite its name, it likes both ‘night’ AND
day.

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text: [df]Now, go!

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]Bring me a hot-tempered monster that needs
a spittoon!

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]Think what kind of hot-tempered monster would
need a spittoon [96] if you know what a spittoon is!

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text: [df]Now, go!

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text: [df]This one’s a gift!

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]First, fill in the blank[b0]
‘------ Quest is my favourite RPG!’

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]Now, bring me one of those!
Specifically, I want the GREEN one...

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text: [df]Now, go!

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]I don’t want just any ‘G-rate’ monster, I want you
to bring me a monster that’s better than good.

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]Now don’t let my question ‘grate’ on your nerves
too much. Just bring me the monster I desire.

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text: [df]Now, go!

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text: [df]Fetch me a ‘manly’ monster!

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]To figure out the type of monster I want,
you’ll have to look closely at the species name.

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]If you look hard enough, I’m sure you’ll see
what I mean by ‘manly’. It’s right in front of you!

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text: [df]Now, go!

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]The monster I seek was meant to stand on a
pedestal...

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]...but it prefers to spend its whole life stomping
around, with the same stony expression on its face.

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text: [df]Now, go!

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]The monster I seek is a man-eating menace that
likes to think outside the box.

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text: [df]Watch out [96] it’s one canny little carnivore!

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text: [df]Now, go!

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]The ghoulish ghost that I seek may have a grin on
its bony face, but it really is a very unhappy soul.

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]Just think about it... Sad souls whose bony grins
hide the torture within...

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text: [df]Now, go!

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]The many-armed demon I seek wears a skull around
its neck.

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]It’s MAL-evolent, it’s WRATH-ful [96] and, er,
it has wings too!

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text: [df]Now, go!

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]I’m sure you still have fond memories of your first
monster, so bring me one of that type!

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]This is absolutely, positively the final problem.
So anyway, do you remember?

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text: [df]Now, go!

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text: [df]What!? You don’t have enough gold!?

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]Then stop wasting my time and ask your mother for
more pocket money or something!

dialogues.speaker: Scoutmaster Shuffles
dialogues.text:
[df]Come back when you’re ready to take the next part
of the test.

dialogues.speaker: Dr Snap
dialogues.text:
[df]What a relief.
If we had lost this...

dialogues.speaker: Dr Snap
dialogues.text:
[df]Ah, [f5].
Did you come to check on me?

dialogues.speaker: Dr Snap
dialogues.text:
[df]Well, don’t you worry, my boy.
I’m quite all right, I assure you.

dialogues.speaker: Dr Snap
dialogues.text:
[df]All the bounders took were my research notes and
a diary.

dialogues.speaker: Dr Snap
dialogues.text:
[df]But I haven’t lost a thing.
It’s all up here, in my head.

dialogues.speaker: Dr Snap
dialogues.text: [df]The important thing is that no one was hurt.

dialogues.speaker: Dr Snap
dialogues.text:
[df]Well, then. Let’s put this unpleasant incident behind
us, shall we?

dialogues.speaker: Dr Snap
dialogues.text: [df]The Scout’s Mark is still safe and sound.

dialogues.speaker: Dr Snap
dialogues.text:
[df]So you, young man, can go back to worrying about
your challenge.

dialogues.speaker: Dr Snap
dialogues.text:
[df]I’ve taught you some of my finest tricks.
[f1][fb][fd]
It would be a shame not to see them put into
practice in the finals!

dialogues.speaker: Kakariin
dialogues.text: [eb][a7][b0] Ah, I’m sorry.

dialogues.speaker: Kakariin
dialogues.text: [eb][a7][b0] I’m not authorised to allow anyone inside.

dialogues.speaker: Solitaire
dialogues.text:
[eb]Oh, this chair is to DIE for! Soft yet supportive,
handsome yet approachable [96][f1][fb][fd]
It’s like sitting on my dream man!

dialogues.speaker: Solitaire
dialogues.text:
[eb]Kicking back in your very own office is one of the
perks of being commissioner.

dialogues.speaker: Solitaire
dialogues.text:
[eb]Ah, if I had won the finals, this chair would’ve
been mine.

dialogues.speaker: Solitaire
dialogues.text:
[eb]Fancy not having a commissioner at a time like this!
Ridiculous! The MSO was falling apart.

dialogues.speaker: Solitaire
dialogues.text:
[eb]Well, I had to put my foot down. Someone needed
to whip this place back into shape.

dialogues.speaker: Solitaire
dialogues.text:
[eb]I suppose I’m the de facto commissioner now.
What can I say?

dialogues.speaker: Solitaire
dialogues.text:
[eb]Why don’t you renew your pledge at Infant Isle?
[f1][fb][fd]
You can pay your last respects to you-know-who,
too.

dialogues.speaker: Solitaire
dialogues.text:
[eb]We need you in top shape for the next scout
challenge. The fans demand nothing less.

dialogues.speaker: Solitaire
dialogues.text:
[eb]And by the time you get back, we’ll be ready to
launch the brand new challenge!

dialogues.speaker: Solitaire
dialogues.text:
[eb]Want to go one-on-one with me?
Take Solitaire’s Challenge.

dialogues.speaker: Solitaire
dialogues.text:
[eb]Actually, I’m not asking. I’m telling.
Remember who’s the Commissioner around here!

dialogues.speaker: Solitaire
dialogues.text:
[eb]It is almost time [96] time for the battle we have been
fated to fight!

dialogues.speaker: Solitaire
dialogues.text:
[eb]You think you’re ready, [f5]?
HA! You’ll never be ready for ME!

dialogues.speaker: Solitaire
dialogues.text:
[eb]Hm? Little loser boy thinks he can win this time?
Oooh, scary.

dialogues.speaker: Solitaire
dialogues.text:
[eb]Fine, fine.
I’ll fight you as often as it takes.

dialogues.speaker: Solitaire
dialogues.text:
[eb]Yes, yes?
What do you want?

dialogues.speaker: Solitaire
dialogues.text:
[eb]You want to know about the key?
Well, if you’re so clever, work it out yourself.

dialogues.speaker: Solitaire
dialogues.text: [eb]It’s your key now.

dialogues.speaker: Solitaire
dialogues.text:
[eb]I didn’t want it anymore, anyway.
It stinks of sewers.

dialogues.speaker: Solitaire
dialogues.text:
[eb]And by the way, Solitaire’s Challenge isn’t
over yet.

dialogues.speaker: Solitaire
dialogues.text:
[eb]We’ve just got started.
More battles lie ahead!

dialogues.speaker: Solitaire
dialogues.text: [eb]You’ve only won the first round, nothing more.

dialogues.speaker: Solitaire
dialogues.text:
[eb]Don’t you dare think I’m finished yet.
I’m not the quitting type.

dialogues.speaker: Solitaire
dialogues.text:
[eb]Come again, any time.
I’ll be waiting, and I won’t be holding back!

dialogues.speaker: Solitaire
dialogues.text:
[eb]This is more than just a social call, isn’t it?
You want to fight.

dialogues.speaker: Solitaire
dialogues.text:
[eb]Fine, fine, if you insist.
I suppose I could do with some practice.

dialogues.speaker: Solitaire
dialogues.text:
[eb]But this time, I won’t be holding back.
Do you hear me?

dialogues.speaker: Rapheal
dialogues.text:

gangsters, and I’ve turned blue with the stress.

dialogues.text:
[ea]Ah, my leetle chum! ’Ave you ’eard about what
’appened at ’eadquarters!? Everything is in chaos!

dialogues.speaker: Black Jacques
dialogues.text:
[ea]All ze monsters we ’ad collected escaped from
zeir cages, and now zey run wild!

dialogues.speaker: Black Jacques
dialogues.text:
[ea]It was getting a leetle too ’airy for me, so I
says to myself[b0] ‘Jacques, it is time for an ’oliday!’

dialogues.speaker: Black Jacques
dialogues.text: [ea]Hmmm. I suppose zere is no ’arm in telling you now.

dialogues.speaker: Black Jacques

shoreline around ze island.

dialogues.speaker: Black Jacques

dialogues.speaker: Black Jacques

dialogues.speaker: Black Jacques
dialogues.text: [ea]I ’eard you went to ze ’eadquarters by yourself.

dialogues.speaker: Black Jacques
dialogues.text:
[ea]What did you say!?

dialogues.speaker: Black Jacques
dialogues.text:
[ea]Oh, ’ow I wish zere was something I could do for
’im...

dialogues.speaker: Black Jacques
dialogues.text:
[ea]But ’ow can I show my face zere now?

dialogues.speaker: Black Jacques
dialogues.text:
[ea]And now you ’ave been entrusted wiz a great
mission, eh?

dialogues.speaker: Black Jacques
dialogues.text:
[ea][a8]sigh[a9] I know YOU will not let ze Warden down like
I did.

dialogues.speaker: Black Jacques
dialogues.text:
[ea]Soon, I shall slip away and leave zis place
forever.

dialogues.speaker: Black Jacques
dialogues.text: [ea]I think maybe, we will never meet again, eh?

dialogues.speaker: Black Jacques
dialogues.text:
[ea]C’est la vie, my leetle chum... I ’ope you succeed
in your mission. Bonne chance, and au revoir!

challenge...
[f1][fb][fd]

[f1][fb][fd]

dialogues.speaker: Slimon
dialogues.text:
[ea]Hey, [f5].

dialogues.speaker: Slimon
dialogues.text:
[ea]I’m really working hard on my slimes’ training,
trying to make them the best they can be.

dialogues.speaker: Slimon
dialogues.text:
[ea]People tend to underestimate slimes, but they can
become pretty powerful if they have a mind to.

dialogues.speaker: Slimon
dialogues.text:
[ea]Anyway, goo you...er, I mean ‘do you’, want to
exchange monsters?

dialogues.speaker: Slimon
dialogues.text:
[ea]Hey, [f5].
How’s the team?

dialogues.speaker: Slimon
dialogues.text:
[ea]My slimes are training hard.
I’m turning them into lean, mean sliming machines...

dialogues.speaker: Slimon
dialogues.text:
[ea]...Well, not so lean, perhaps...but I AM close to
realising my dream...

dialogues.speaker: Slimon
dialogues.text:
[ea]...ANY-way. Do you want to muck...er, I mean
‘make’, a trade?

dialogues.speaker: Slimon
dialogues.text: [ea]Today, I want to tell you about my dream.

dialogues.speaker: Slimon
dialogues.text:
[ea]I want to build a battle arena...
[f1][fb][fd]
...just for SLIMES!

dialogues.speaker: Slimon
dialogues.text:
[ea]Slimes could train there as much as they liked and
finally win a bit of respect for themselves.

dialogues.speaker: Slimon
dialogues.text:
[ea]And you know, there’s NOTHING better than diving
into big wobbly pile of slimes and smothering[96]

dialogues.speaker: Slimon
dialogues.text:
[ea]Uh...oh, er, did I say that out loud?

dialogues.text:
[ea]Hey there, [f5]. I take it you’re competing
in Solitaire’s Challenge too.

dialogues.speaker: Slimon
dialogues.text:
[ea]You haven’t heard anything about any prize money,
have you?

dialogues.speaker: Slimon
dialogues.text:
[ea]Only, I really need some capital.
You know, to build my Slimopolis.

dialogues.speaker: Slimon
dialogues.text:
[ea][a8]sigh[a9] My dream, my Slimopolis! My very own jiggly,
wobbly, wibbly slime arena! Just think of it! [a8]drool[a9]

dialogues.speaker: Slimon
dialogues.text:
[ea]...You’d rather not? Oh, okay.
So, er, you’re just here to swap monsters then?

dialogues.speaker: Slimon
dialogues.text:
[ea]Oh? You’ve changed your mind?
Stop ‘mucking’ about!

dialogues.speaker: Slimon
dialogues.text:
[ea]Oh, come on! Ick’ll be fun!
...Er, I mean, ‘It’ll be fun!’

dialogues.speaker: Slimon
dialogues.text: [ea]I’ve got something slimy with your name on it!

dialogues.text: [eb]Hi, [f5].

dialogues.speaker: Kitty
dialogues.text:
[eb]You haven’t seen my little sister, have you?

dialogues.speaker: Kitty
dialogues.text:
[eb]Actually, she’s an amazing girl.

dialogues.speaker: Kitty
dialogues.text:
[eb]She’s really crafty in battle [96] she likes to use
tricks to keep her opponents off balance.

dialogues.speaker: Kitty
dialogues.text:
[eb]She inherited ALL the brains in our family...
I got stuck with the good looks and personality.

dialogues.speaker: Kitty
dialogues.text:
[eb]But what more do you need, right?
Now, do you want to swap monsters?

dialogues.speaker: Kitty
dialogues.text: [eb][a8]sigh[a9] I just don’t know what to do, [f5].

dialogues.speaker: Kitty
dialogues.text:
[eb]I’ve poured all my love into rearing my monsters.

dialogues.speaker: Kitty
dialogues.text:

dialogues.text:

dialogues.speaker: Kitty

[eb]I was curious about this ‘challenge’ event of which
the hoi polloi[96]

dialogues.speaker: Lizzy
dialogues.text:
[eb]...er, that is to say, the working class people, are
so fond. So I decided to enter it myself.

have to excuse me.

dialogues.speaker: Lizzy
dialogues.text:
[eb]I don’t like to speak ill of people, but she really is
a most BEASTLY woman, don’t you think?

dialogues.speaker: Lizzy
dialogues.text:
[eb]Just because she owns her very own island,
everyone assumes she must be a wonderful person!

dialogues.speaker: Lizzy
dialogues.text:
[eb]It makes my blood boil! Still, whatever advantages
she may have over me in real estate and fame...
[f1][fb][fd]
...I MORE than make up for in beauty and grace!

dialogues.speaker: Lizzy
dialogues.text:
[eb][a8]sigh[a9] Of course, just about ANYONE could say
that...

dialogues.speaker: Lizzy
dialogues.text:
[eb]Anyway, enough chit-chat.
Would you like to exchange some monsters?

dialogues.speaker: Lizzy
dialogues.text:
[eb]If you were to fight in the finals, what manner of
monsters would you have in your team?

dialogues.speaker: Lizzy
dialogues.text:
[eb]I know what I’D pick [96] king squids, without a
doubt...

dialogues.speaker: Lizzy
dialogues.text:
[eb]I love their smooth, sinewy tentacles...how they
bind their victims with an irresistible embrace...
[f1][fb][fd]
...before slithering forward to deliver the final...

dialogues.speaker: Lizzy
dialogues.text:
[eb]...Oh, haha.
Listen to me, getting carried away again...

dialogues.speaker: Lizzy
dialogues.text:
[eb]SO, shouldn’t we be swapping monsters or
something?

dialogues.speaker: Lizzy
dialogues.text:
[eb]Ah, it’s my working class hero! This Solitaire’s
Challenge is rather intriguing, don’t you think?

dialogues.speaker: Lizzy
dialogues.text:
[eb]Apparently, some of the island events have been
incorporated into the challenge...

dialogues.speaker: Lizzy
dialogues.text:
[eb]Obviously this means more profits for the organisers
of those events...

dialogues.speaker: Lizzy
dialogues.text:
[eb]There’ve been whispers about deals with the
arena and monetary ‘gifts’ to the Commissioner.

dialogues.speaker: Lizzy
dialogues.text:
[eb]That Solitaire certainly has her fingers in a lot of
pies.

dialogues.speaker: Lizzy
dialogues.text:
[eb]Still, what can WE do? Best not to think about it.
Let’s exchange monsters instead.

dialogues.speaker: Lizzy
dialogues.text: [eb]Oh, you can’t possibly mean that!

dialogues.speaker: Lizzy
dialogues.text:
[eb]This is no time for false modesty [96] I’m SURE you’d
be honoured to trade with me!

dialogues.speaker: Lizzy
dialogues.text: [eb]Well I never!

dialogues.speaker: Lizzy
dialogues.text:
[eb]Are you implying that I’m not good enough to
swap monsters with you!?

dialogues.speaker: Ooligan
dialogues.text:
[ea]So give us a shout next time yer see me, awright,
son?

dialogues.speaker: Ooligan
dialogues.text:
[d0]1[f5] is now friends with the occasionally
objectionable Ooligan!

dialogues.speaker: Ooligan
dialogues.text:
[ea]So give us a shout next time yer see me, awright,
son?

dialogues.speaker: Ooligan
dialogues.text:
[d0]1[f5] is now friends with the occasionally
objectionable Ooligan!

dialogues.speaker: Ooligan
dialogues.text:
[ea]There you are, [f5]!
I’ve been waitin’ ’ere for bleedin’ AGES!

dialogues.speaker: Ooligan
dialogues.text:
[ea]Thing is, I ’ad this idea that maybe you an’ me
could swap some monsters or somefin’.

dialogues.speaker: Ooligan
dialogues.text: [ea]Wot d’yer reckon?

dialogues.speaker: Ooligan
dialogues.text: [ea]Ah, if it ain’t me good mate, [f5]!

dialogues.speaker: Ooligan
dialogues.text:
[ea]Listen, son. I ’eard somefin’ on the grapevine wot I
reckon might come in ’andy...

dialogues.speaker: Ooligan
dialogues.text:
[ea]A little bird [96] actually, it was a bloke [96] told me
yer can win darkonium at the arena on Xeroph Isle.

dialogues.speaker: Ooligan
dialogues.text:
[ea]Sounds good, don’t it? I’d rather fight for the stuff
than go on a bloomin’ treasure ’unt.

dialogues.speaker: Ooligan
dialogues.text:
[ea]Now, I ’elped you, so you ’elp me, eh?
Let’s swap some monsters!

dialogues.speaker: Ooligan
dialogues.text:
[ea]’Ello, [f5]!
Tell me, wot’s yer favourite monster?

dialogues.speaker: Ooligan
dialogues.text: [ea]I’m pers’nally like dragony-style monsters, see.

dialogues.speaker: Ooligan
dialogues.text:
[ea]Oooh, I loves it when they breath fire over
ev’ryfin’... Proper get’s me goin’, it does!

dialogues.speaker: Ooligan
dialogues.text:
[ea]’Course, back where I come from, they called me
‘Ooligan the Dragon Tamer’!

dialogues.speaker: Ooligan
dialogues.text:
[ea]So, ’avin’ divulged me secret past, I’m sure yer
know me well enough to swap monsters, eh?

dialogues.speaker: Ooligan
dialogues.text:
[ea]’Ello, [f5].
I ain’t an ’appy scout today, an’ that’s the truth!

dialogues.speaker: Ooligan
dialogues.text:
[ea]This new Sally-tears Challenge is RUBBISH!
It don’t ’ave ’alf the atmosphere o’ the old one.

dialogues.speaker: Ooligan
dialogues.text:
[ea]Me dream was to battle you in the championship
final.

dialogues.speaker: Ooligan
dialogues.text:
[ea]But there ain’t no way that’ll ever ’appen in this
all-new bleedin’ challenge.

dialogues.speaker: Ooligan
dialogues.text:
[ea]O well. I s’pose we’ll just ’ave to swap monsters
instead.

dialogues.speaker: Ooligan
dialogues.text:
[ea]O, ’ave an ’eart, son!
Just one little swap?

dialogues.speaker: Ooligan
dialogues.text:
[ea]So that’s ’ow it is, is it!?
An’ I thought we was mates!

dialogues.speaker: Chuck
dialogues.text:
[ea][a8]sigh[a9] No one talk to me.
Maybe becaussse me smell funny?

dialogues.speaker: Chuck
dialogues.text:
[ea]...Anyway, you and me friendsss now.
So if we meet again, you say ‘hello’.

dialogues.speaker: Chuck
dialogues.text: [ea][a8]guuurgle-urgle[a9]

dialogues.speaker: Chuck
dialogues.text:
[d0]1[f5] and the scabby scout called Chuck
have become fast friends!

dialogues.speaker: Chuck
dialogues.text:
[ea][a8]BURP[a9] Me look like rotting corpssse, but me
actually scout.

dialogues.speaker: Chuck
dialogues.text: [ea]Next time, you and me swap monsssters, okay?

dialogues.speaker: Chuck
dialogues.text:
[d0]1[f5] and the scabby scout called Chuck
have become fast friends!

dialogues.speaker: Chuck
dialogues.text: [ea][a8]gurgle[a9] Hello [f5].

dialogues.speaker: Chuck
dialogues.text:
[ea]People alwaysss point at me and say,
‘Ew! Look at the walking corpse!’

dialogues.speaker: Chuck
dialogues.text:
[ea]But they can’t see the REAL me.
[a8]sigh[a9] People isss so shallow.

dialogues.speaker: Chuck
dialogues.text: [ea]Anyway. You want trade monsters?

dialogues.speaker: Chuck
dialogues.text: [ea]Me makesss friends with a scout called Tryger.

dialogues.speaker: Chuck
dialogues.text: [ea]He ask, ‘You like cosplay too?’

dialogues.speaker: Chuck
dialogues.text: [ea]But why would me dress up as rotting corpssse?

dialogues.speaker: Chuck
dialogues.text:
[ea]It so frustrating. People can’t sssee past green
flaky flesh and bad breath.

dialogues.speaker: Chuck
dialogues.text: [ea]People ssso rude.

dialogues.speaker: Chuck
dialogues.text:
[ea]Me upset.
Perhaps monster swap make me happy?

dialogues.speaker: Chuck
dialogues.text: [ea][a8]burrrp[a9] Hello, [f5].

dialogues.speaker: Chuck
dialogues.text: [ea]Me almost collect ten darkonium cryssstals.

dialogues.speaker: Chuck
dialogues.text: [ea]Me almossst reach goal. [a8]BURP[a9]

dialogues.speaker: Chuck
dialogues.text: [ea]If me reach goal, me have lotsss of girlfriends.

dialogues.speaker: Chuck
dialogues.text:
[ea]Me be challenge champion and be famousss.
Me be Green Bays Casanova.

dialogues.speaker: Chuck
dialogues.text:
[ea][a8]guuurgle gaaargle[a9] Today me happy.
You and me swap monsters, okay?

dialogues.speaker: Chuck
dialogues.text:
[ea]Listen, [f5].
My dream ssstill alive.

dialogues.speaker: Chuck
dialogues.text:
[ea][a8]gurgle[a9] Me make harem of groupies.
Me have plan.

dialogues.speaker: Chuck
dialogues.text:
[ea]First, me win Solitaire’sss Challenge.
Me be popular.

dialogues.speaker: Chuck
dialogues.text: [ea]Famousss man once said, ‘I have a dream.’

dialogues.speaker: Chuck
dialogues.text: [ea]Me too have dream. [a8]burp[a9]

dialogues.speaker: Chuck
dialogues.text:
[ea]Me can see it!
Me can see it!

dialogues.speaker: Chuck
dialogues.text:
[ea]Me have groupies stuck to me like flies on rotting
banana.

dialogues.speaker: Chuck
dialogues.text:
[ea]Okay, [f5].
Now you and me swap monsters!

dialogues.speaker: Chuck
dialogues.text:
[ea][a8]gurrrgggle[a9] Why you say no?
Me want swap monsters!

dialogues.speaker: Chuck
dialogues.text:
[ea]Eh!? Why not?
Pleassse? It be fun.

dialogues.speaker: Tryger
dialogues.text:
[ea]I know, I know. My costume is SO convincing, you
thought I was the real thing...

dialogues.speaker: Tryger
dialogues.text:
[ea]...but I assure you, I won’t bite, hahaha! So let’s
swap monsters next time we meet, all right?

dialogues.speaker: Tryger
dialogues.text:
[d0]1[f5] has made friends with the seriously
stripy scout called Tryger!

dialogues.speaker: Tryger
dialogues.text:
[ea]Oh, hello [f5].
You know, I had quite an adventure the other day.

dialogues.speaker: Tryger
dialogues.text: [ea]I found myself in a fight with a certain scout...

dialogues.speaker: Tryger
dialogues.text:
[ea]But his team had some of the most idiotic monsters
I’ve ever had the misfortune to meet.

dialogues.speaker: Tryger
dialogues.text:
[ea]Would you believe they actually attacked ME
instead of my monsters!?

dialogues.speaker: Tryger
dialogues.text:
[ea]I DO try to explain that it’s only a costume, but
people just don’t understand the cosplay lifestyle.

dialogues.speaker: Tryger
dialogues.text:
[ea]Anyway, speaking of monsters [96] would you like to
trade?

dialogues.speaker: Tryger
dialogues.text: [ea]Oh, hello, [f5].

dialogues.speaker: Tryger
dialogues.text: [ea]I’m afraid you’ve caught me at a rather bad time.

dialogues.speaker: Tryger
dialogues.text:
[ea]Recently, I’ve really been in two minds about which
costume to wear.

dialogues.speaker: Tryger
dialogues.text:
[ea]Should I stick with the weartiger, or go with my new
hacksaurus costume?

dialogues.speaker: Tryger
dialogues.text:
[ea]Well, I thought I’d try being a hacksaurus for a bit,
and popped outside to explore the island...

dialogues.speaker: Tryger
dialogues.text:
[ea]...but I couldn’t go more than ten paces without
being attacked by overenthusiastic scouts!

dialogues.speaker: Tryger
dialogues.text:
[ea]So I scurried back here as fast as I could and
changed right back into my weartiger costume.

dialogues.speaker: Tryger
dialogues.text:
[ea]But enough about my adventures [96] shall we swap
monsters?

dialogues.speaker: Tryger
dialogues.text:
[ea]Oh dear, oh dear. [f5], you’ll never
guess what’s happened to me now.

dialogues.speaker: Tryger
dialogues.text:
[ea]I have a female lips on my team, and it’s fallen
head-over-heels in love with me.

dialogues.speaker: Tryger
dialogues.text: [ea]The poor, besotted thing keeps trying to KISS me!

dialogues.speaker: Tryger
dialogues.text:
[ea]It just doesn’t understand that humans and
monsters were never meant to be together!
[f1][fb][fd]
...At least, not in THAT way.

dialogues.speaker: Tryger
dialogues.text:
[ea]Ahem, speaking of monsters...you wouldn’t fancy
swapping any, would you?

dialogues.speaker: Tryger
dialogues.text:
[ea]What do you mean? You’d rather hear more about
my cosplay adventures?

dialogues.speaker: Tryger
dialogues.text:
[ea]Look, I can tell you more stories later.
What about trading monsters?

dialogues.speaker: Tryger
dialogues.text:
[ea]Oh well, if you’ve made up your mind, I won’t try
to talk you into it...

dialogues.speaker: Missy
dialogues.text:
[eb]I’m going to be the next Monster Scout Challenge
idol. I already have a fan club.

dialogues.speaker: Missy
dialogues.text:
[eb]Hey, if we meet again, let’s exchange monsters,
okay?

dialogues.speaker: Missy
dialogues.text:
[d0]1[f5] is now friends with the scouting
idol-in-training known as Missy!

dialogues.speaker: Missy
dialogues.text:
[eb]Because of you, I wasn’t able to fight Miss
Solitaire in the finals.

dialogues.speaker: Missy
dialogues.text:
[eb]You’re stupid! I HATE you!
I’m going to get you back, just you wait!

dialogues.speaker: Missy
dialogues.text: [eb]Because YOU’RE not the next challenge idol [96] I am!

dialogues.speaker: Missy
dialogues.text:
[d0]1[f5] is now friends with the scouting
idol-in-training known as Missy!

dialogues.speaker: Missy
dialogues.text: [eb]I’m planning on becoming the next challenge idol.

dialogues.speaker: Missy
dialogues.text:
[eb]Which means I have to fight the current idol,
and beat her.

dialogues.speaker: Missy
dialogues.text: [eb]That’s why I entered the challenge.

dialogues.speaker: Missy
dialogues.text:
[eb]So anyway, shall we swap monsters?
I mean that’s what you’re here for, right?

dialogues.speaker: Missy
dialogues.text: [eb]I first met Miss Solitaire on Palaish Isle.

dialogues.speaker: Missy
dialogues.text:
[eb]She looked SO cool, the way she squished those
slimes one after another.

dialogues.speaker: Missy
dialogues.text:
[eb]After that, I promised myself that one day, I would
become a super scout like her!

dialogues.speaker: Missy
dialogues.text:
[eb]So anyway, shall we swap monsters?
I mean that’s what you’re here for, right?

dialogues.speaker: Missy
dialogues.text:
[eb]You know, I think of Solitaire sort of like a big
sister, but my REAL big sister is a scout too.

dialogues.speaker: Missy
dialogues.text:
[eb]Of course, she’s nowhere NEAR as cool and
amazing as Solitaire...

dialogues.speaker: Missy
dialogues.text:
[eb]I mean, all she cares about are her stupid cat
monsters!

dialogues.speaker: Missy
dialogues.text:
[eb]Hmph. She really is useless when it comes to
scouting.

dialogues.speaker: Missy
dialogues.text:
[eb]So anyway, shall we swap monsters?
I mean that’s what you’re here for, right?

dialogues.speaker: Missy
dialogues.text:
[eb]Isn’t that just like Solitaire? One minute she’s a
scout, the next she’s Commissioner of the MSO!

dialogues.speaker: Missy
dialogues.text:
[eb]I really set my sights high when I picked her as my
rival!

dialogues.speaker: Missy
dialogues.text:
[eb]Still, I’m not giving up.
One day, I’m going to be even bigger than Solitaire!

dialogues.speaker: Missy
dialogues.text:
[eb]So anyway, shall we swap monsters?
I mean that’s what you’re here for, right?

dialogues.speaker: Missy
dialogues.text:
[eb]Ha! I don’t believe you. I think you’re really
DESPERATE to swap monsters with me.

dialogues.speaker: Missy
dialogues.text:
[eb]So come ON.
Let’s just trade, okay?

dialogues.speaker: Missy
dialogues.text:
[eb]Hmph. Fine.
See if I care.

dialogues.speaker: Missy
dialogues.text: [eb]I never wanted your stupid monsters anyway!

dialogues.speaker: Rapheal
dialogues.text: [ea]Next time we meet, perhaps we can swap monsters.

dialogues.speaker: Rapheal
dialogues.text:
[d0]1[f5] is now friends with Rapheal, the
only scout slimier than Slimon!

dialogues.speaker: Rapheal
dialogues.text: [ea]Next time we meet, perhaps we can swap monsters?

dialogues.speaker: Rapheal
dialogues.text:
[d0]1[f5] is now friends with Rapheal, the
only scout slimier than Slimon!

dialogues.speaker: Rapheal
dialogues.text:
[ea]Oh, hello my friend. I hope you’re doing well,
because I’m certainly not.

dialogues.speaker: Rapheal
dialogues.text:
[ea]You see, I found this half-eaten sandwich,
and I was so VERY hungry...

dialogues.speaker: Rapheal
dialogues.text:
[ea]Oh dear... [a8]RUMBLE[a9] M-My stomach feels like it’s
going to explode!

dialogues.speaker: Rapheal
dialogues.text:
[ea]B-But I think I could just about manage a monster
exchange, if that’s what you want? [a8]RRRUMBLE[a9]

dialogues.speaker: Rapheal
dialogues.text:
[ea]I’ve never told you my tale of woe, have I?
[f1][fb][fd]
You see, gambling ruined my life. I’m so mired in
debt that I fear I shall never again break even.

dialogues.speaker: Rapheal
dialogues.text:
[ea]You mustn’t make the same mistake I did! Resist
the lure of the dice! Devote yourself to scouting!

dialogues.speaker: Rapheal
dialogues.text:
[ea]...Though I suppose scouting is something of a
gamble too, when you think about it...

dialogues.speaker: Rapheal
dialogues.text:
[ea]But enough about my woes! The demon debt can’t
prevent me from exchanging monsters! Shall we?

dialogues.speaker: Rapheal
dialogues.text:
[ea]I really shouldn’t linger in Green Bays...
I should flee while I still have the chance.

dialogues.speaker: Rapheal
dialogues.text: [ea]But I can’t just give up on my scouting dreams.

dialogues.speaker: Rapheal
dialogues.text: [ea]No, only one course of action remains...

dialogues.speaker: Rapheal
dialogues.text:
[ea]I’m going to have to win the challenge before the
debt collectors catch up with me!

dialogues.speaker: Rapheal
dialogues.text:
[ea]And for that, I need a good team.
Shall we swap monsters?

dialogues.speaker: Rapheal
dialogues.text: [ea]Thank heavens for this new commissioner!

dialogues.speaker: Rapheal
dialogues.text:
[ea]Because of her, there’s still a chance I can win a
tournament and pay off my debts!

dialogues.speaker: Rapheal
dialogues.text:
[ea]Oh, I’m so excited! Tonight, I’m going to celebrate
with a steaming bowl of spaghetti!
[f1][fb][fd]
Actually, the last time I did that, I ended up eating
one of my tentacles...

dialogues.speaker: Rapheal
dialogues.text: [ea]Anyway, shall we swap monsters?

dialogues.speaker: Rapheal
dialogues.text:
[ea]Shhh! I know what you’re going to say...
But let’s just trade monsters anyway!

dialogues.speaker: Rapheal
dialogues.text: [ea]Well you’re no fun at all.

dialogues.speaker: Bob A. Job
dialogues.text:
[ea]This is my first time in Green Bays, and frankly,
I’m a bit overwhelmed.

dialogues.speaker: Bob A. Job
dialogues.text:
[ea]I really need someone to show me the ropes.
Maybe you could help me out?

dialogues.speaker: Bob A. Job
dialogues.text:
[d0]1[f5] has made friends with the man from
the mainland, Bob A. Job!

dialogues.speaker: Bob A. Job
dialogues.text:
[ea]This is my first time in Green Bays, and frankly,
I’m a bit overwhelmed.

dialogues.speaker: Bob A. Job
dialogues.text:
[ea]I really need someone to show me the ropes.
Maybe you could help me out?

dialogues.speaker: Bob A. Job
dialogues.text:
[d0]1[f5] has made friends with the man from
the mainland, Bob A. Job!

dialogues.speaker: Bob A. Job
dialogues.text:
[ea]When I exchange monsters, I always try to make
sure that they’re both of equal value.

dialogues.speaker: Bob A. Job
dialogues.text:
[ea]That’s fairest for everyone, as I’m sure you’ll
agree.

dialogues.speaker: Bob A. Job
dialogues.text:
[ea]I don’t know about here in Green Bays, but that’s
how we do things on the mainland.

dialogues.speaker: Bob A. Job
dialogues.text:
[ea]So, what do you say?
Shall we exchange monsters?

dialogues.speaker: Bob A. Job
dialogues.text:
[ea]Normally, I like to collect monsters of the machine
family...

dialogues.speaker: Bob A. Job
dialogues.text:
[ea]...but there doesn’t seem to be many of them here
in Green Bays.

dialogues.speaker: Bob A. Job
dialogues.text:
[ea]If you DO happen to find any, please come and see
me. Maybe we could make a deal.

dialogues.speaker: Bob A. Job
dialogues.text:
[ea]Speaking of which, would you like to swap
monsters?

dialogues.speaker: Bob A. Job
dialogues.text: [ea]Before we get to trading, let me tell you a story.

dialogues.speaker: Bob A. Job
dialogues.text:
[ea]Once, a long time ago, I worked as a monster scout
for a certain kingdom.

dialogues.speaker: Bob A. Job
dialogues.text:
[ea]I became rather famous for it, in fact.
Famous and wealthy.
[f1][fb][fd]
And with wealth came women. LOTS of women.
I had everything I’d ever wanted.

dialogues.speaker: Bob A. Job
dialogues.text:
[ea]But what I didn’t have was freedom.
Scouting wasn’t fun any more, it was just a job.
[f1][fb][fd]
I longed to be answerable to no one, to live the
life of a wandering scout... So I gave it all up.

dialogues.speaker: Bob A. Job
dialogues.text:
[ea]It’s years since I left that life behind...
But I don’t regret what I did.
[f1][fb][fd]
I mean, who needs a mountain of money and hoards
of beautiful, willing, young[96] ARRRRRRGH!!!
[f1][fb][fd]
...Let’s change the subject, eh!?
How about we swap some wom[96] MONSTERS?

dialogues.speaker: Bob A. Job
dialogues.text:
[ea]I heard about the catastrophe on Infern Isle.
Green Bays really is quite dangerous.

dialogues.speaker: Bob A. Job
dialogues.text:
[ea]But that’s exactly why it teems with such
abundant monster life.

dialogues.speaker: Bob A. Job
dialogues.text:
[ea]You see, every place has its good points and bad
points. Just like monsters.

dialogues.speaker: Bob A. Job
dialogues.text:
[ea]Which is why swapping monsters can be
advantageous to both parties. So, shall we?

dialogues.speaker: Bob A. Job
dialogues.text:
[ea]Swapping monsters can help both our teams,
so why not?

dialogues.speaker: Bob A. Job
dialogues.text: [ea]Yes, well, it’s your choice, I suppose.

dialogues.speaker: Bob A. Job
dialogues.text:
[ea]But remember[b0] though you lose something in every
exchange, you gain something as well.

dialogues.speaker: Rusty
dialogues.text:
[df]And ye be one of the youngest. Nought wrong with
that though. Ye seem like an honest young fellow.

dialogues.speaker: Rusty
dialogues.text:
[df]Well, I think that’s everything. Give me a shout if
you have anything you’d like to swap.

dialogues.speaker: Rusty
dialogues.text:
[d0]1[f5] has made friends with the veteran
scout called Rusty!

dialogues.speaker: Rusty
dialogues.text:
[df]I’ve been a scout for nigh on fifty years, but I’ve
never been able to reach the top.

dialogues.speaker: Rusty
dialogues.text:
[df]I reckon ye be different though.
’Seems to me yer a natural born scout.

dialogues.speaker: Rusty
dialogues.text:
[df]You’ve already achieved a great deal at a very
young age...
[f1][fb][fd]
...but don’t let it go to yer head. Keep working at
it, and ye could be something really special.

dialogues.speaker: Rusty
dialogues.text: [df]...Now then, how about a little monster swap?

dialogues.speaker: Rusty
dialogues.text:
[df]I want to see how great ye can become.
Won’t you trade with me?

dialogues.speaker: Rusty
dialogues.text:
[df]So ye aren’t ready to trade?
I had you pegged as a more adventurous type.

dialogues.speaker: Solitaire
dialogues.text: [eb]Oh, it’s you.

dialogues.speaker: Solitaire
dialogues.text: [eb]Argh! Can’t you take a HINT!?

dialogues.speaker: Solitaire
dialogues.text:
[eb]I’m TRYING to forget that debacle of a finals,
you know.

dialogues.speaker: Solitaire
dialogues.text:
[eb]If we’d have been allowed to have a proper fight,
there’s no WAY you’d have won.

dialogues.speaker: Solitaire
dialogues.text:
[eb]Still, my new challenge will give me the opportunity
to set the record straight.

dialogues.speaker: Solitaire
dialogues.text:
[eb]Providing, of course, you actually manage to fulfil
the entry requirements!

dialogues.speaker: Solitaire
dialogues.text:
[eb]So what are you waiting for? You’ve got some
qualifying to do [96] go on, chop chop!

dialogues.speaker: Solitaire
dialogues.text:
[d0]1[f5] renews his, er, acquaintance with
the charming scout named Solitaire.

dialogues.speaker: Solitaire
dialogues.text: [eb]Oh. You again?

dialogues.speaker: Solitaire
dialogues.text:
[eb]I suppose you think I’m here skipping work or
something.

dialogues.speaker: Solitaire
dialogues.text:
[eb]Well, you’re wrong. Getting out to the islands is
one of my most important duties.

dialogues.speaker: Solitaire
dialogues.text:
[eb]As the Commissioner, I have to fight the scouts who
qualify for Solitaire’s Challenge.

dialogues.speaker: Solitaire
dialogues.text:
[eb]So it’s absolutely essential that I stick to my
training and keep myself sharp.

dialogues.speaker: Solitaire
dialogues.text:
[eb]Anyway, now that you’re here, why don’t we trade
monsters?

dialogues.speaker: Solitaire
dialogues.text:
[eb]Oh, I know what you’re up to [96] you’re playing hard
to get.

dialogues.speaker: Solitaire
dialogues.text:
[eb]You say ‘no’, but we both know you REALLY want
to say ‘yes’!

dialogues.speaker: Solitaire
dialogues.text:
[eb]Tsk. And I had all these useless monsters I wanted
to get rid of...

dialogues.speaker: Solitaire
dialogues.text:
[eb]...Er, did I say that out loud? What I MEANT to say
was...
[f1][fb][fd]
...you are missing a GOLDEN opportunity, buster!

dialogues.text: [eb]Listen, I’m going to tell you something for free.

dialogues.speaker: Solitaire
dialogues.text:
[eb]As you probably already suspect, I don’t like being
called Ginny Rummy.

dialogues.speaker: Solitaire
dialogues.text: [eb]Solitaire is my name, and that’s all there is to it.

dialogues.speaker: Solitaire
dialogues.text:

dialogues.speaker: Solitaire
dialogues.text:
[eb]She entered me in the challenge under my real
name [96] WITHOUT my permission!

dialogues.speaker: Solitaire
dialogues.text:
[eb]That name just does NOT suit me. Solitaire is way
more my style, y’know?

dialogues.speaker: Solitaire
dialogues.text:

dialogues.speaker: Wingle
dialogues.text:
[ea]Given a choice between fight and flight, you’d
choose to fight, right?

dialogues.speaker: Wingle
dialogues.text: [ea]Excellent choice.

dialogues.speaker: Percy Weed
dialogues.text:
[ea]Er, excuse me.
Would you care for a battle?

dialogues.speaker: Percy Weed
dialogues.text: [ea]Oh, goody!

dialogues.speaker: Sebeastian
dialogues.text:
[ea]Hey, loser.
Wanna try and take me on?

dialogues.speaker: Sebeastian
dialogues.text:
[ea]Right.
You asked for it!

dialogues.speaker: Victoria
dialogues.text:
[eb]What, you want a battle?
Is that why you’re talking to me?

dialogues.speaker: Victoria
dialogues.text:
[eb]Suits me just fine.
Now show me what you got!

dialogues.speaker: Wyrma
dialogues.text:
[eb]Excuse me!
Could I tempt you to a little battle?

dialogues.speaker: Wyrma
dialogues.text:
[eb]Oh, thank you! But do be gentle with me, okay?
I haven’t done this too often.

dialogues.speaker: Orephelia
dialogues.text:
[eb]I-I’m no good at battles, you know.
I never win.

dialogues.speaker: Orephelia
dialogues.text: [eb]Do you really want to fight someone like me?

dialogues.speaker: Orephelia
dialogues.text: [eb]Well, please don’t hurt me.

dialogues.speaker: Nick
dialogues.text: [ea][a8]giggles[a9] Oh, looks like it’s my lucky day.

dialogues.speaker: Nick
dialogues.text: [ea]You and me, we fight, right?

dialogues.speaker: Nick
dialogues.text: [ea]Dinner time!

dialogues.speaker: Christough
dialogues.text:
[ea]In this world, power is everything.
We shall fight, young scout!

dialogues.speaker: Christough
dialogues.text: [ea]There can be only one!

dialogues.speaker: Seedy Player
dialogues.text:
[ea]Hey, kid.
Do me a favour and fight me, okay?

dialogues.speaker: Seedy Player
dialogues.text:
[ea]Heheheh, now THAT’S what I’m talkin’ about...
The kid’s got guts!

dialogues.speaker: Fauna
dialogues.text:
[eb]Hey, sir?
Do you want to have a battle?

dialogues.speaker: Fauna
dialogues.text:
[eb]Yippee!
A battle, a battle!

dialogues.speaker: Milicia
dialogues.text:
[eb]Huh?
Excuse me, but are you flirting with me?

dialogues.speaker: Milicia
dialogues.text:
[eb]Oh, I see.
Well, I suppose a battle would be acceptable.

dialogues.speaker: Milicia
dialogues.text:
[eb][a8]chuckle[a9] A battle it is then.
But don’t think I’m going to go easy on you!

dialogues.speaker: Maggie
dialogues.text:
[eb]Hmph. Nice hair.
You don’t look so tough.

dialogues.speaker: Maggie
dialogues.text:
[eb]I’ll give you a practice fight.
How about it, spiky head?

dialogues.speaker: Maggie
dialogues.text: [eb]Okay. Let me show you how it’s done!

dialogues.speaker: Francis Drake
dialogues.text:
[ea]Ah, perfect timing!
I’m in the mood for a fight. Shall we?

dialogues.speaker: Francis Drake
dialogues.text:
[ea]Capital. Do your best, now!
I’d rather not embarrass you!

dialogues.speaker: Kelvin Klein
dialogues.text: [ea]Yo, kid. Wanna fight?

dialogues.speaker: Kelvin Klein
dialogues.text: [ea]Bring it on!

dialogues.speaker: Norm
dialogues.text:
[ea]Our paths have crossed. There’s no going back.
We’ve no choice now but to FIGHT!

dialogues.speaker: Norm
dialogues.text:
[ea]Enough talking.
Let battle commence!

dialogues.speaker: Daisy
dialogues.text:
[eb]You want a piece of me?
Come and get it, if you dare.

dialogues.speaker: Daisy
dialogues.text:
[eb]Excellent.
This might prove to be...stimulating.

dialogues.speaker: Sweetie
dialogues.text:
[eb]Hey, you’re a cutie.
I’ll be your sparring partner, if you like.

dialogues.speaker: Sweetie
dialogues.text:
[eb][a8]snigger[a9] Okay, but that was your last chance to
turn me down!

dialogues.speaker: Destiny
dialogues.text: [eb]I think fate has brought us together today.

dialogues.speaker: Destiny
dialogues.text: [eb]We must do battle.

dialogues.speaker: Destiny
dialogues.text: [eb]Yes. Let us follow the path and discover our fate.

dialogues.speaker: Wilhelm Splitz
dialogues.text:
[df]Well aren’t you a lively-looking young fellow!
Wilhelm Splitz at your service.

dialogues.speaker: Wilhelm Splitz
dialogues.text:
[df]What’s that? You want to fight an old codger like
me!?

dialogues.speaker: Wilhelm Splitz
dialogues.text:
[df][a8]chuckle[a9] I still have a few tricks up my sleeve,
young ’un!

dialogues.speaker: Gardini
dialogues.text:
[df]I may not look it, but I’m a scout jus’ like
yerself. Fancy a fight?

dialogues.speaker: Gardini
dialogues.text:
[df]Right then! Get ready to find out why yer
oughta respect yer elders!

dialogues.speaker: Grandead
dialogues.text:
[df]When two scouts cross paths, nothing can
prevent them from...from...err...

dialogues.speaker: Grandead
dialogues.text:
[df]Now, what is it...?
Ah, I remember [96] from FIGHTING!

dialogues.speaker: Grandead
dialogues.text:
[df]I’m jolly strong, you know.
You’ll not get the better of me!

dialogues.speaker: Wingle
dialogues.text:
[ea]Given a choice between fight and flight, you’d
choose to fight, right?

dialogues.speaker: Wingle
dialogues.text: [ea]Excellent choice.

dialogues.speaker: Percy Weed
dialogues.text:
[ea]Er, excuse me.
Would you care for a battle?

dialogues.speaker: Percy Weed
dialogues.text: [ea]Oh, goody!

dialogues.speaker: Sebeastian
dialogues.text:
[ea]Hey, loser.
Wanna try and take me on?

dialogues.speaker: Sebeastian
dialogues.text:
[ea]Right.
You asked for it!

dialogues.speaker: Victoria
dialogues.text:
[eb]What, you want a battle?
Is that why you’re talking to me?

dialogues.speaker: Victoria
dialogues.text:
[eb]Suits me just fine.
Now show me what you got!

dialogues.speaker: Wyrma
dialogues.text:
[eb]Excuse me!
Could I tempt you to a little battle?

dialogues.speaker: Wyrma
dialogues.text:
[eb]Oh, thank you! But do be gentle with me, okay?
I haven’t done this too often.

dialogues.speaker: Orephelia
dialogues.text:
[eb]I-I’m no good at battles, you know.
I never win.

dialogues.speaker: Orephelia
dialogues.text: [eb]Do you really want to fight someone like me?

dialogues.speaker: Orephelia
dialogues.text: [eb]Well, please don’t hurt me.

dialogues.speaker: Nick
dialogues.text: [ea][a8]giggles[a9] Oh, looks like it’s my lucky day.

dialogues.speaker: Nick
dialogues.text: [ea]You and me, we fight, right?

dialogues.speaker: Nick
dialogues.text: [ea]Dinner time!

dialogues.speaker: Christough
dialogues.text:
[ea]In this world, power is everything.
We shall fight, young scout!

dialogues.speaker: Christough
dialogues.text: [ea]There can be only one!

dialogues.speaker: Seedy Player
dialogues.text:
[ea]Hey, kid.
Do me a favour and fight me, okay?

dialogues.speaker: Seedy Player
dialogues.text:
[ea]Heheheh, now THAT’S what I’m talkin’ about...
The kid’s got guts!

dialogues.speaker: Fauna
dialogues.text:
[eb]Hey, sir?
Do you want to have a battle?

dialogues.speaker: Fauna
dialogues.text:
[eb]Yippee!
A battle, a battle!

dialogues.speaker: Milicia
dialogues.text:
[eb]Huh?
Excuse me, but are you flirting with me?

dialogues.speaker: Milicia
dialogues.text:
[eb]Oh, I see.
Well, I suppose a battle would be acceptable.

dialogues.speaker: Milicia
dialogues.text:
[eb][a8]chuckle[a9] A battle it is then.
But don’t think I’m going to go easy on you!

dialogues.speaker: Maggie
dialogues.text:
[eb]Hmph. Nice hair.
You don’t look so tough.

dialogues.speaker: Maggie
dialogues.text:
[eb]I’ll give you a practice fight.
How about it, spiky head?

dialogues.speaker: Maggie
dialogues.text: [eb]Okay. Let me show you how it’s done!

dialogues.speaker: Francis Drake
dialogues.text:
[ea]Ah, perfect timing!
I’m in the mood for a fight. Shall we?

dialogues.speaker: Francis Drake
dialogues.text:
[ea]Capital. Do your best, now!
I’d rather not embarrass you!

dialogues.speaker: Kelvin Klein
dialogues.text: [ea]Yo, kid. Wanna fight?

dialogues.speaker: Kelvin Klein
dialogues.text: [ea]Bring it on!

dialogues.speaker: Norm
dialogues.text:
[ea]Our paths have crossed. There’s no going back.
We’ve no choice now but to FIGHT!

dialogues.speaker: Norm
dialogues.text:
[ea]Enough talking.
Let battle commence!

dialogues.speaker: Daisy
dialogues.text:
[eb]You want a piece of me?
Come and get it, if you dare.

dialogues.speaker: Daisy
dialogues.text:
[eb]Excellent.
This might prove to be...stimulating.

dialogues.speaker: Sweetie
dialogues.text:
[eb]Hey, you’re a cutie.
I’ll be your sparring partner, if you like.

dialogues.speaker: Sweetie
dialogues.text:
[eb][a8]snigger[a9] Okay, but that was your last chance to
turn me down!

dialogues.speaker: Destiny
dialogues.text: [eb]I think fate has brought us together today.

dialogues.speaker: Destiny
dialogues.text: [eb]We must do battle.

dialogues.speaker: Destiny
dialogues.text: [eb]Yes. Let us follow the path and discover our fate.

dialogues.speaker: Wilhelm Splitz
dialogues.text:
[df]Well aren’t you a lively-looking young fellow!
Wilhelm Splitz at your service.

dialogues.speaker: Wilhelm Splitz
dialogues.text:
[df]What’s that? You want to fight an old codger like
me!?

dialogues.speaker: Wilhelm Splitz
dialogues.text:
[df][a8]chuckle[a9] I still have a few tricks up my sleeve,
young ’un!

dialogues.speaker: Gardini
dialogues.text:
[df]I may not look it, but I’m a scout jus’ like
yerself. Fancy a fight?

dialogues.speaker: Gardini
dialogues.text:
[df]Right then! Get ready to find out why yer
oughta respect yer elders!

dialogues.speaker: Grandead
dialogues.text:
[df]When two scouts cross paths, nothing can
prevent them from...from...err...

dialogues.speaker: Grandead
dialogues.text:
[df]Now, what is it...?
Ah, I remember [96] from FIGHTING!

dialogues.speaker: Grandead
dialogues.text:
[df]I’m jolly strong, you know.
You’ll not get the better of me!
